method: Independent read-only inspection of delivery/verify_checkout.py, FINAL-HANDOFF.md, .gitattributes, recorded temporary-checkout proof and local/checkout audits. No tests/model calls or Git mutations performed by this reviewer.
conclusion: No blocking or unsafe operation observed for the recorded execution environment. The raw-byte preservation strategy addresses the previously demonstrated Git clean-filter hash mismatch without rewriting local historical files or Agent code.

git_safety_checks.temporary_index_and_objects: read-tree/add/renormalize/write-tree run with GIT_INDEX_FILE and GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY pointing inside the generated TemporaryDirectory; existing real Git objects are read through alternates.
git_safety_checks.temporary_refs: update-ref targets the newly initialized temporary checkout, with original Git directory/worktree overrides cleared in the environment used for that operation.
git_safety_checks.real_refs_and_index: Script records HEAD and ls-files --stage entries before/after; proof reports both unchanged. The comparison demonstrates index entries, not a byte-for-byte assertion about stat-cache serialization.
git_safety_checks.no_commits_or_push: No git commit, commit-tree, push, reset, checkout of the real worktree, or history rewrite in the inspected utility.
git_safety_checks.file_scope: Proposed filenames come from Git relative path lists plus the protected manifest; newline/missing-file rejection and --literal-pathspecs avoid accidental wildcard expansion.
git_safety_checks.raw_byte_reindex: Targeted git add --renormalize after -text forces Git to reload original worktree bytes; it does not rewrite files. This is materially different from normalizing evidence text.
git_safety_checks.cleanup: TemporaryDirectory cleanup is confined to an explicitly generated system-temp path with parent/prefix assertions; no recursive deletion of workspace evidence.
git_safety_checks.output_preservation: Four distinct new output paths are required; existing receipts are not overwritten.

recorded_proof.scope_note: Receipts produced by this check and the subsequently frozen final stage manifest are added after the checked snapshot.

limits: Temporary refs point at an existing commit while index/worktree materialize the proposed tree; this is a checkout/integrity test, not a commit or remote-CI test.
Full proposed-tree pack size is not a guaranteed future remote push size.
Final stage-paths/raw-byte-paths/submission-manifest and receipts created after that snapshot are explicitly outside its earlier file count; preserve that scope qualifier.
The prior evidence-scope review described the pre-fix attribute policy; it is preserved as historical diagnostic evidence, not a claim that the current attributes are still broken.

nonblocking_findings.finding: Checkout audit has no .env and exact_configured_credential_available=false; local audit has true. Clarify that exact current-credential scanning is supplied by the local audit, while the isolated checkout intentionally contains no credentials.
nonblocking_findings.suggestion: Add a short clarification in FINAL-HANDOFF without copying secrets to the checkout.

nonblocking_findings.finding: .gitattributes says never renormalize frozen evidence while handoff correctly requires targeted Git reindex under -text. The behavior is correct but that comment can confuse future users.
nonblocking_findings.suggestion: Say never rewrite/reformat working evidence; targeted Git reindex under disabled text filters preserves raw bytes.

nonblocking_findings.finding: The git init invocation does not explicitly pass the sanitized base_env. Current environment contains none of the five inspected Git override variables, so the recorded execution is not affected.
nonblocking_findings.suggestion: Pass env=base_env to git init for consistency with the isolation contract; no Agent change needed.

nonblocking_findings.finding: Postcommit checks create new receipt files under delivery/review. Later git status may show those receipts even when code is unchanged.
nonblocking_findings.suggestion: Optionally state that newly generated postcommit receipts should be reviewed/archived separately, not mistaken for unstaged implementation changes.
